issue.title: [sFlow] after move the slow ptf test to run with python3, the test which can finish with 50s, now it will take 5161s

failure.body:
**Description**
After move the ptftests/sflow_test.py to run with python3, the test which will be finished in 1 mins in python2, will take almost 2 hrs.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run the sflow test, and add breakpoint before the ptf test start
2. run the ptf test on the ptf docker with python2, and with python3.
    /root/env-python3/bin/ptf --test-dir ptftests/py3 sflow_test --platform-dir ptftests --platform remote -t "enabled_sflow_interfaces=['Ethernet64', 'Ethernet0', 'Ethernet80', 'Ethernet16'];active_collectors=['collector0'];dst_port=8;testbed_type='t0-64';router_mac='<IPV6>';sflow_ports_file='/tmp/sflow_ports.json';agent_id='<IP>'" --relax --debug info --log-file /tmp/TestSflowCollector.test_sflow_config.log --socket-recv-size 16384

ptf --test-dir ptftests/py3 sflow_test --platform-dir ptftests --platform remote -t "enabled_sflow_interfaces=['Ethernet64', 'Ethernet0', 'Ethernet80', 'Ethernet16'];active_collectors=['collector0'];dst_port=8;testbed_type='t0-64';router_mac='<IPV6>';sflow_ports_file='/tmp/sflow_ports.json';agent_id='<IP>'" --relax --debug info --log-file /tmp/TestSflowCollector.test_sflow_config.log --socket-recv-size 16384

resolution.title: [sFlow] Fix sFlow TC and improve execution time
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Andrii-Yosafat Lozovyi <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Summary:  After sFlow ptftests migrated to python3, executing time of a single sFlow ptftest increased from 50-80 seconds to 5000 seconds. As investigation showed, executing time of function that send pkt's increased significantly.

When executed using `python3 `it takes about ~11-18 seconds to send 512 pkt's:
```
<IPV6>.563  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet124  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.623860
<IPV6>.655  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet112  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.087558
<IPV6>.359  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet120  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.700587
<IPV6>.719  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet116  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.351208
<IPV6>.629  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet124  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.899076
<IPV6>.386  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet112  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.748628
<IPV6>.228  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet120  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.833997
```

When executed using `python2`:
```
<IPV6>.563  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet116  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.042150
<IPV6>.612  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet124  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.046037
<IPV6>.738  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet112  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.123535
<IPV6>.876  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet120  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.133869
<IPV6>.034  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet116  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.153847
<IPV6>.165  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet124  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.127286
<IPV6>.316  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet112  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.147911
<IPV6>.465  root      : INFO    : Sending 512 pkts to Ethernet120  time_it_took_to_send <IPV6>.144826
```

It looks like the problem was in difference of how threads work in python 2 vs python3, by updating TC logic with using events in threads this issue was fixed. Also removed unused import and fixed some bad indentation.
Fixes #5938

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
As for now 1 sFlow ptftest can run around 5000 seconds, which significantly increase executing time of Sflow suite.
PR decrease execution time of sFlow TC on python3 by updating TC logic.
#### How did you do it?

#### How did you verify/test it?
